_comment: firmware-agent-kit project config. Copy to <project>/.claude/firmware.json (or run /fw-init). Remove _comment keys. Unknown -> null.

lint._comment_isr_functions: extra regexes for functions that run in interrupt context (callbacks registered at runtime)

_comment_format: on_edit=true clang-formats the edited lines after every edit (needs clang-format + .clang-format)

analysis._comment_misra_rules_file: path to your licensed MISRA C:2012 rule texts (optional; without it only rule IDs are shown)

guard._comment_confirm_flash: true = ask before every flash command (shared lab boards / production fixtures)
guard._comment_vendor_edits: ask | deny | allow - edits under protected_paths
